decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - 3/  Within three months of the date of this approval a scheme for protecting each residential accommodation from excessive internal noise transmission from the adjacent flat shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed within six months of the written approval of the details submitted.

Condition : 4 - 4/  The hardstanding area to the front curtilage of the property shall be maintained at all times for the provision of two off-street parking spaces for the occupiers of the flats hereby approved.
description: Continued use of premises as two self contained flats
